content.text:
Rather than
      - name: Build and install all modules
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: bash ci/run.sh --stage build

Please build each module one at a time
I’ll find the workflow step and split it into separate module builds, using the compiling and directory-structure skills to check the build interface and order.

input.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat .agents/skills/compiling/SKILL.md .agents/skills/directory-structure/SKILL.md","max_output_tokens":6000}));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"rg -n 'Build and install all modules|stage build|AGENTS' .github ci; rg --files -g AGENTS.md -g '*run*' ci .github","max_output_tokens":5000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short; cat .github/workflows/ubuntu-latest.yml ci/run.sh","max_output_tokens":11000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat .agents/skills/testing-and-verification/SKILL.md; rg -n 'install|gkeyll' Makefile | tail -65","max_output_tokens":4000}));

content.text: The Makefile has per-module install targets. I’ll give each module its own workflow step in dependency order, then install the Gkeyll executable. Each step will keep separate logs and the existing cancellation condition. I’m also using the testing-and-verification skill for the CI checks.

input.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('.github/workflows/ubuntu-latest.yml')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''      - name: Build and install all modules
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: bash ci/run.sh --stage build
'''
new = '\n'.join('''      - name: Build and install MODULE
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          source ci/common.sh
          ci_log MODULE-install make -C "$CI_SOURCE_DIR" -j"$CI_JOBS" MODULE-install
'''.replace('MODULE', module) for module in ['core', 'moments', 'vlasov', 'gyrokinetic', 'pkpm', 'gkeyll'])
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
python3 ci/test-workflow.py
 git diff --check
 git diff --stat","max_output_tokens":2000}));

content.text:
Updated [ubuntu-latest.yml](/home/maxwell-rosen/gkeyll-fork/.github/workflows/ubuntu-latest.yml:41) to build and install modules in separate sequential steps: core → moments → vlasov → gyrokinetic → pkpm → gkeyll.

Each step retains cancellation handling and separate logging. All four CI helper tests and whitespace checks passed; full compilation wasn’t run.
